Facebook Fraud : Why you shouldn't use facebook advertising.

True story. Facebook advertising is just a waste of money. A few years ago fan page I was managing gained a lot of likes trough Facebook ad bringing people who were engaged after they liked the page. After, lets say 2012, Facebook ads were delivering just "dead" likes. Last year I wanted to promote a new page. In a day there were almost 500 likes. The ad was delivering new likes every day but there were no post likes, shares or comments. Same thing goes fro website click ads. It delivered traffic to website but with enormous bounce rate. Some of my friends also experienced exactly the same problem with their pages. On July 8th Facebook made some changes regarding CPC calculation. Two day experiment gave the same results, there were no improvement in the quality of likes.

Thank you for posting this. I really feel people should be aware of this before they even consider paying for Facebook promotion. You are literally paying for likes to "boost" your page, but it doesn't do anything more than give you a temporary feeling of success. Promoting your photography can be very challenging and you are better off using the money you would use for Facebook ads and putting it into making your own website and portfolio.
